hypotheses.title: Batch 63: Dual Breakthrough Targeting EXCELLENT/SPECTACULAR via Breadth and Orthogonal Cashflow
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Deploys a two-pronged strategy to conquer the country challenge leaderboard: (1) Breadth Expansion on Candidate 2: Shifting the Fitness 1.88 engine to TOP3000 expands cross-sectional breadth by 3x, targeting Sharpe >= 2.15 to trigger the 10% platform improvement override. (2) Accrual-Clean Operating Cashflow Yield (fnd6_fopo) + VWAP in Sector Scope: Substitutes accounting income with physical operational cash inflows to eliminate portfolio correlation. (3) EBITDA Yield + VWAP Reversion in Market Scope: Capitalizes on cash enterprise valuation. (4) 1-Year Put Volatility Downside Skew in Sector Scope: Exploits downside crash protection premia, structurally decorrelated from call options.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if operational cashflow yields or put crash premia reflect distress rather than high quality.
